name: barbell muscle clean
description: Pull a barbell from the floor to your shoulders using only arm and hip drive, with no re-bending of the knees. A good clean-technique builder.
instructions: Set up over the bar with hands just outside your knees and your back flat.
Pull the bar off the floor, extending your hips and knees.
Shrug and pull the elbows high, keeping the bar close.
Rotate your elbows under and catch the bar on your shoulders without dropping into a squat.
Lower the bar back down under control.
